Notes: Generated from the client resource database perk records (type 1000036; Gamecode.dll loads them by GetIdentityVec(0xF4264)): 36 bytes = type, Id, version, ItemId, PreviousId, Flags, ProfessionMask, Field14, Field18. A line is the PreviousId chain from a record with PreviousId 0; Tier is the position in that chain. Where a perk is the PreviousId of several perks (global research branches), each branch is its own line. Name is the perk item's items.dat name.

Flags (Gamecode.dll N3Msg_Is*): 0x01 special perk, 0x02 alien (AI) perk, 0x40/0x80 research (0x80 Field18 is multiplied by 1000), 0x100 usable only in the owner's land control area. 0x04/0x08/0x10/0x20 appear only with 0x02 and are not decoded. Line Flags are tier 1's; a tier lists its own only where they differ.
